scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: flock -x /tmp/electrical-estimator-codegen.lock -c 'pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run codegen && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
